parameters.query:
SELECT TOP 1 pr.RunId, pr.ProjectId, p.Slug, p.Name AS ProjectName, p.Idea
FROM ProjectRuns pr
JOIN Projects p ON p.ProjectId = pr.ProjectId
WHERE pr.Status = 'Pending' AND pr.CurrentStage = 'AIQ-PF-04-ProductStrategy'
ORDER BY pr.StartedAt ASC;
UPDATE ProjectRuns SET Status = 'Running' WHERE RunId = '{{ $json.RunId }}';

VALUES
('{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.ProjectId }}', '{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.RunId }}', 'product-strategy.md', 'projects/{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.Slug }}/strategy/product-strategy.md'),
('{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.ProjectId }}', '{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.RunId }}', 'business-model.md', 'projects/{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.Slug }}/strategy/business-model.md'),
('{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.ProjectId }}', '{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.RunId }}', 'opportunity-analysis.md', 'projects/{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.Slug }}/strategy/opportunity-analysis.md'),
('{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.ProjectId }}', '{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.RunId }}', 'report-04-product-strategy.md', 'projects/{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.Slug }}/logs/report-04-product-strategy.md');

parameters.command: =cd /opt/aiq/product-factory/repo && git pull --rebase && git add projects/{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.Slug }} && git commit -m "Product strategy: {{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.Slug }}" && git push

parameters.query: UPDATE ProjectRuns SET Status = 'Waiting', CurrentStage = 'AIQ-PF-05-ProductArchitecture' WHERE RunId = '{{ $('Separar Documentos').item.json.RunId }}';
